extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n where n is a real number, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Power Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form f(x) = x^n where n is a real number.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponent n in the Power Rule can be any real number, not just a positive integer.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is a constant and f(x) is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Sum Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable, then d/dx[f(x) + g(x)] = f'(x) + g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Difference Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable, then d/dx[f(x) - g(x)] = f'(x) - g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of Natural Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(e^x) = e^x; the exponential function is its own derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of General Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(a^x) = a^x · ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form a^x, including the natural exponential e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Logarithm with base e, appearing in the derivative of a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of position with respect to time: v(t) = s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function describing position over time, whose derivative is velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of velocity with respect to time: a(t) = v'(t) = s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of the cost function: MC = C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function whose derivative gives marginal cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative interpreted as a rate of change in physics, biology, and economics.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation of computing a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation; antidifferentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse process of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration as inverse operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the derivative; appears as acceleration.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A constant factor in differentiation rules.
